description: Ferman component spec: every design-system component, the internal Field, Popover and Scrim, and the DS additions, with their Flutter class, props, variants, sizes, states, keyboard behaviour, semantics and tier. Written by careful reading of the design export (G02); schema and rules in docs/COMPONENTS.md, which is rendered from this file by tools/icons (dart run icons:component_spec). Checked by tools/icons/test/component_spec_test.dart.

tiers.1: Used by the M1 screens: boards f6, f6a, a1-1, a1-2b, a1-2c, a1-5, a11-1, a11-1w, a11-1b, a12-2a to a12-2d, and the always-present parts of the FmWindow, FmStart and FmSettings building blocks (panes enabled in M1). Built to full depth first.
tiers.2: Used later: inside document content (Doc* pages), later panels (FmEditPanel, FmComments, FmFormPanel), conditional FmWindow parts that need a later feature, or later boards. Built complete visually with data passed in.

stateVocabulary.focusVisible: Keyboard focus ring (CSS :focus-visible, or the field ring on :focus-within) (G22).
stateVocabulary.disabledWithReason: Disabled with a tooltip and semantics hint that says why; "Available in a future version" for unshipped features (G10).
stateVocabulary.selected: The chosen tab, option or item (aria-selected).
stateVocabulary.checked: A checked checkbox, radio, segment or menu item (aria-checked).
stateVocabulary.loading: Busy (aria-busy or a spinner in place).
stateVocabulary.other: Component-specific names (for example unsaved, dropBefore, metaBelow) describe a drawn state of that component only.

triggers.pointer: Driven by the mouse, pen or touch.
triggers.keyboard: Driven by keyboard focus or keys.
triggers.data: Driven by the data shown (value, selection, counts).
triggers.drag: Driven by a drag over the component.
triggers.system: Driven by the environment (text direction, mode, reduced motion).

types.KeyCaps: List<String>: key-cap labels already resolved for the platform from the one shortcut table (⌘ ⌥ ⇧ on macOS; Ctrl, Alt, Shift on Windows and Linux).
types.IconName: Generated enum, app/lib/design/icons/icon_name.g.dart; its drawing is IconNameElements.elements in icon_data.g.dart.
types.FermanMode: Enum with id, label and icon (component FERMAN_MODES).
types.AnnotationTool: Enum with id, label, icon, shortcut, colored and hasMenu (component ANNOTATION_TOOLS).
types.T: The option value type of a generic component (Select, Radio, SegmentedControl).
types.n/a: The DS prop has no Flutter parameter; see omitReason.

rules: Dart class names are the design-system names; files that also import Material or the widgets library hide or prefix the clashing names (Icon, IconButton, Tooltip, Dialog, Badge, Radio, Switch, TextField, Banner, Checkbox) (ADR 0011).
Enum props become Dart enums whose values are the DS values in lower camel case; "default" becomes "standard" because it is a Dart keyword (see "enums").
React "default*" props for values are dropped: Ferman widgets are controlled and the state lives in providers. "defaultOpen" becomes "initiallyOpen" for UI-local disclosure state.
onClick becomes onPressed and onChange becomes onChanged; className, style, id, key and ref have no Flutter parameter.

Every interactive component shows the design system focus ring on keyboard focus: 2 px ink with a 2 px gap (--focus-ring), the inset ring (--focus-ring-inset) on tabs, segments and list rows, the field ring on inputs, the ink tint inside menus (G22).

Disabled with a reason: disabled styling, the reason as tooltip and semantics hint, still focusable so keyboard and screen-reader users can read the reason, activation does nothing. Unshipped features use the localized "Available in a future version" and get a BACKLOG.md entry (G10).
Colours, sizes, radii and durations come from tokens.g.dart; durations drop to zero under reduced motion (tokens).
Page-tuned components (PageMark, TextEditBox, PdfFormField, Highlight, Stamp, ThumbnailBadges) keep their colours in every theme: the page is white.
Right to left mirrors the layout, never the PDF canvas; icons mirror only when directional.

KbdTone.source: adherence Kbd.tone ("default" is a Dart keyword, so it becomes "standard")

FieldSize.source: adherence TextField.size, NumberStepper.size, ColorPicker.size; bundle Select and FontPicker

AnnotationColor.source: bundle Highlight COLORS (StickyNote uses the first five, AnnotationTools yellow, green, blue, pink, red, ink)

WindowPlatform.source: FmWindow platform (mac, win); linux added by Q12 (G15)

ThumbnailBadge.source: 00 Fixes f5 and DS additions badgeDemo (fixed order)

components.name: Icon
components.tierReason: Every M1 screen draws icons.
components.summary: Paints one design glyph from its generated element data at the design system's 1.5 stroke; decorative unless labelled.

props.notes: Generated enum (tools/icons).
Screens use 10, 11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24 and more.
In viewBox units, as the SVG attribute: 2 for 12 px glyphs and badges; FmWindow caption glyphs use 1 and 1.2, FmPhone 1.8 and 2.2.
null inherits the DefaultTextStyle colour (CSS color), else an IconTheme colour, like currentColor.
Set: role img with this label. Null: excluded from semantics (aria-hidden).
Null, the Dart default, uses IconName.directional; true or false overrides one use (decision 3). See notes.

props.omitReason: CSS hook; use layout widgets.
CSS hook.

states.name: rtlMirrored
states.notes: Mirrored horizontally under right-to-left when flipped; the PDF canvas never mirrors.

notes: The DS default for flipRtl is false and boards flip individual uses with data-fm-flip. The design flips exactly the eight IconName values marked directional, so the Flutter default follows IconName.directional; the few unflipped uses of arrow-right, chevron-left and chevron-right in mobile data lists can pass flipRtl: false if a board shows them unmirrored (DESIGN_INVENTORY §7).
An unknown name cannot happen in Dart: IconName is a closed enum.

Painted, not loaded: a CustomPainter draws IconNameElements.elements (app/lib/design/icons/icon_data.g.dart, the sealed IconElement classes of icon_element.dart) on the 24 × 24 grid scaled to size, path data parsed with path_parsing. The stroke is strokeWidth × size / 24 wide with round caps and joins; an element is filled only when IconElement.filled is true. No SVG package (flutter_svg pulls in http); the SVG files in app/assets/icons are the provenance-tracked export and are not loaded at run time (decision 19).
